description: Interactive runner for DVC (Data Version Control) data-management commands in this Orbit Wars repo. Triggered explicitly by the user with /dvc. Presents the available DVC operations (status / dag / diff / metrics show / pull / push / fetch / add / commit) via AskUserQuestion, confirms riskier ones, and executes them with the repo-specific conventions baked in (uv via the backend venv, shared cache at /Users/user/project/orbit-wars/.dvc/cache, S3 remote `s3` with AWS profile `orbit-wars`). Use whenever the user types /dvc or asks to run DVC commands such as "push my data", "pull the latest weights", "show DVC status", "what changed in the pipeline outputs", or "register this directory with DVC", and they have not already specified the exact subcommand themselves.
